description: This Java class 'AssetProfileImportService' handles importing, preparing, saving, and logging actions related to AssetProfile entities within the Thingsboard platform. It extends a base import service and interacts with asset profile data, including setting ownership, preparing data, saving or updating entities, and logging actions.

classes.name: AssetProfileImportService
classes.description: Service class for importing AssetProfile entities, extending base import functionalities, handling entity preparation, saving, and logging.

methods.name: setOwner
methods.description: Sets the tenant ID as the owner of the AssetProfile.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepares the AssetProfile by converting external IDs to internal IDs for rule chain, dashboard, and edge rule chain.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves or updates the AssetProfile, and performs additional calculations if it's the final import attempt or all external IDs are updated.

methods.name: onEntitySaved
methods.description: Logs the action (add or update) after the AssetProfile is saved.

methods.name: deepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the AssetProfile.

methods.name: cleanupForComparison
methods.description: Cleans up the AssetProfile for comparison purposes.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Returns the entity type, which is ASSET_PROFILE.
